title: SEC1: background discovery task has no graceful shutdown mechanism
description: spawn_discovery_task() runs an infinite loop with no CancellationToken or shutdown hook. If kithd ever needs graceful shutdown (e.g., reload config, systemd stop), the discovery task will not terminate — the process must force-exit. This is documented as intentional in Phase 1, but future maintainers should know this is by design. Consider using tokio::select! with a shutdown signal in Phase 2 if graceful reload becomes a requirement. Not a bug in current architecture, but flagged for awareness.
